values.en: In a dependent type theory with the dependent-product closure required by Girard's diagonal construction, allowing a universe 𝒰 to inhabit itself makes the theory inconsistent; in particular, False is derivable. Bare self-membership without the required product structure is not by itself the theorem. A predicative hierarchy avoids the cycle by placing Type u in Type (u+1).
values.zh-CN: 在具备 Girard 对角构造所需依赖积闭包的依赖类型论中，若允许宇宙 𝒰 属于自身，则该理论不一致；特别地，可以推出 False。若缺少所需的依赖积结构，仅有自身归属并不足以得到该定理。直谓宇宙层级通过令 Type u 属于 Type (u+1) 来避免这一循环。
